company.summary: MJØSBIL AS is a private limited company (aksjeselskap) registered under detaljhandel med deler og utstyr til motorvogner (NACE 47.820), based in Gjøvik, founded 1988-11-15. Its verified website describes it as: “Mjøsbil utfører verkstedtjenester som EU-kontroll, service mm. I tillegg leverer vi reservedeler, olje og batterier, dekk og tilhengere.” Public brand: Mjøsbil. Registered activity: Reparasjon, kjøp og salg av nye og brukte biler, samt andre varer og tjenester, og det som dermed er forbundet. Selskapet kan delta i andre foretak og erverve fast eiendom. Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, company accounts): revenue NOK 121.6 m, operating result NOK 2.8 m, net result NOK 1.2 m, total assets NOK 39.5 m, equity NOK 2.2 m. The period closed with a profit. Change from 2024 to 2025: revenue went from NOK 126.9 m to NOK 121.6 m (-4%); net result went from NOK 124.7 k to NOK 1.2 m (+845%); equity went from NOK 1.0 m to NOK 2.2 m (+115%). Financial position in 2025: operating margin 2.3%; equity ratio 5.6%. Calculated from the filed figures above. Registered employees: 84. Leadership in the official register: Aage Strandbakken (managing director); Jens Petter Markestad (chair of the board); Grethe Solberg (board member); Stian Strand Molstadkroken (board member); plus 3 further roles. 7 registered workplaces in Dokka, Fåvang, Hunndalen, Lillehammer, Otta. Official website https://mjosbil.no/ (identity check: labelled organisation number); company-linked profiles on facebook, instagram. Latest company-published activity: “Dekk til last, anlegg og landbruk” (2026-09-21). Most recent registry event: Registered employee count updated (2026-11-12). Not established from checked sources: active job ads (not available). Missing information is not treated as zero.
